picks.why: Covers the Ninth Circuit's Sunday arguments in DOJ's California election lawsuit and ties it to the Alaska suit. Adedayo Fashanu, Aaron Parnas and Lisa Remillard also covered the Alaska suit this week.

Reports the Oct 17 death in ICE custody of a Mexican national and lawful permanent resident, the first of fiscal 2027; his daughter says staff would not give him his medications. Kate Morrissey also reported an ICE custody death this week.
Former students of Excel College, an unaccredited Christian college in North Carolina, accuse it of using a non-disparagement agreement in its honor code to keep sexual assaults quiet.

Sets Chalkbeat and the Illinois Answers Project's spending analysis against its own predictions for Chicago's school board races; District 4A is the most expensive so far, with more than half a million dollars spent.
A video on the reports of AI agents accessing U.S. bank accounts; the title argues it is not the real story. Gary Marcus and Rowan Cheung also covered the bank reports this week.
